in_sanskrit.name: Momeen
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Calm, Peaceful
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Momeen एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Momeen is derived from the Arabic word 'mumina' which means 'peaceful, tranquil, safe and secure'. The name Momeen is used in both Hindu and Urdu cultures and is often given to babies as a symbol of hope and calmness.
